notes: Read all 73 numbered source lines before editing. L1-2 imports (useState, react-i18next useTranslation), L3-5 lucide icons Database/GitBranch/Radio/Shield/Cpu/Play, L6 shared Input/Button/Textarea, L7 @tanstack/react-query useMutation, L8-11 the ./ToolCard ./ResultPanel ./BackendTool ./helpers(apiFetch) sibling imports, L13 MQTT Test Tool banner, L15-56 MqttTestTool, L58-60 the Infrastructure Section banner, and L62-73 the InfrastructureSection export were each considered and reproduced natively.

Self-contained by necessity: the four sibling modules the source imports (L8 ./ToolCard, L9 ./ResultPanel, L10 ./BackendTool, L11 ./helpers apiFetch) plus ./constants ICON_COLOR_MAP are NOT separate entries in the file-parity manifest (only InfrastructureSection.tsx, tools/CronParser.tsx and tools/UnixPermissionTool.tsx under devtools/ are targets), so importing them from native would never resolve. ToolCard, ResultPanel, BackendTool, MqttTestTool and apiFetch are therefore reproduced natively in this one file. This makes the port longer than the 73-line source even though behaviour is identical — the web source's logic was split across 5 files (~73 + 29 + 36 + 63 + 14 lines).

apiFetch (helpers L8-21) ported verbatim: request<Record<string,unknown>>(`/dev-tools/${endpoint}`, { method, ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}) }) inside try/catch returning { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Request failed' }. Uses the native web-parity request client (../../../../api/client). The /dev-tools/{endpoint} path and the endpoint slugs db-stats / migration-status / mqtt-test / env-check / runtime-info are preserved exactly.

MqttTestTool (L15-56) preserved verbatim: state names topic + message (L17-18), useMutation mutationFn apiFetch('mqtt-test','POST',{topic,message}) (L20-22), ToolCard icon=Radio color=amber title t('Mqtt') description t('Mqtt Desc') (L25), the Topic Input with placeholder 'test/topic' and the Radio leading icon (L27-33), the Message label + Textarea rows=3 placeholder '{"key": "value"}' (L34-42, native multiline TextInput numberOfLines=3 textAlignVertical=top), the Send Test primary button with loading + Play icon (L43-45), and the mutation.data-gated ResultPanel with data={mutation.data.error ? undefined : mutation.data} and error={typeof mutation.data.error === 'string' ? mutation.data.error : undefined} (L46-52).

BackendTool (./BackendTool L20-63) reproduced: useMutation apiFetch(endpoint, method, bodyBuilder?.()), the Run primary button (loading + Play), the success/danger Badge with dot reading t('Success')/t('Failed'), and the ResultPanel — all data-gated identically. InfrastructureSection (L62-72) renders the same five tools in source order with the same colors and endpoints: Database/cyan/db-stats, GitBranch/green/migration-status, MqttTestTool, Shield/purple/env-check, Cpu/amber/runtime-info; t('Db Stats'/'Db Stats Desc'/'Migrations'/'Migrations Desc'/'Env Check'/'Env Check Desc'/'Runtime'/'Runtime Desc') preserved verbatim.

Native-safe adaptations: lucide icons -> short colored glyph badges (Database=DB, GitBranch=GB, Radio=RA, Shield=SH, Cpu=CP) inside the web ICON_COLOR_MAP colored ring (cyan/green/purple/amber/red translucent bg + ring, color text), and Play -> a '\u25B6' glyph on the run buttons. ResultPanel's <pre> -> a maxHeight 256 ScrollView with a monospace AppText (web max-h-64 overflow-auto). The shared CopyButton's navigator.clipboard.writeText -> a native-safe writeClipboard that uses navigator.clipboard when present (react-native-web) and reports an explicit unavailable state on iOS/Android where no clipboard module is bundled, never flipping to 'Copied' on failure (web parity). The 'grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2' wrapper -> a single-column vertical stack (the sub-lg / mobile rendering of the source grid).

react-i18next is not wired in native, so useTranslation()'s t (L16, L63) is replaced by useNativeTranslationFallback returning the i18n key when no default is given (i18next returns the key for missing translations, so t('Db Stats') -> 'Db Stats') or the supplied English default for the CopyButton keys (common.copyButton.copy/copied -> Copy/Copied). Every i18n key is preserved verbatim. An optional style + testID prop pair was added to the exported InfrastructureSection for native composability (the web component takes no props); it defaults to {} and a stable 'infrastructure-section' testID.

No DOM, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, browser HTML elements (div/span/pre/input/textarea/button), or old web ui components are imported — only react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator/Platform/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View), @tanstack/react-query useMutation, the shared native GlassPanel + AppText, the theme tokens, and the native web-parity request client.
